Engineer Pay Log

More than a digital time book

Engineer Pay Log brings shift entry, Crew Book tools, bidding, seniority planning, pay tracking, and time-slip follow-up into one LIRR Engineer-focused app.

Fast shift entry & earningsTrack assignments, report/release times, crew names, penalties, meals, overtime, and yearly earnings — with smart autofill where it helps.
Crew Book Assistance & job lookupLook up passenger and relief assignments by date, review report/release times and relief coverage, compare jobs, and view the matching Crew Book assignment image.
Bid Sheet & Trim AssistantsBuild a bid sheet in priority order, compare available assignments, and use current roster data to explore jobs below your seniority position.
Paychecks, claims & Time Slip CenterEstimate pay, track penalties and claims, save time-slip photos, monitor deadlines, and keep Wage Examiner follow-up organized.
Cloud sync with offline supportYour time book follows your account across devices while local work remains available when your connection is limited.
Built for the way LIRR Engineers workDate-aware Crew Book revisions, relief-job detail, Quick Job Lookup, Community Notes, and railroad-specific workflows are built into the app.

Deadhead Watch

Save the LIRR trains or other transportation you normally use for each assignment day.

Trips belong to the day your assignment starts. If your job releases after midnight, EPL automatically treats the trip home as the following calendar day. Non-LIRR transportation can be saved too, but only LIRR trains will be checked against GTFS.

Automatic monitoring: Once your LIRR commute has a saved schedule baseline, EPL periodically checks it for published schedule changes even when the PWA is closed. If notifications are enabled, Deadhead Watch can alert you when a saved commute needs review.

Using My Job fills only the assignment, location, scheduled times, and Shift Type = Own. You can freely edit the daily shift afterward without changing this saved template.

Reference & Help

Details that are useful when you need them, without cluttering everyday settings.

Pay Rules & RatesRate table Jul 29, 2026 • 8-hour minimum • reference details›
Minimum8 hoursNight Diff.8:00 PM–5:59 AMDaily Cert$10 normal shift
View full pay rules
Pay scale: Automatically determined from Employment Start Date using the BLET rate tables effective July 29, 2026 (60%, 80%, 90%, 100%).
Minimum: 8 hours per paid shift.
Normal OT: actual time over 8 hours.
Full-shift OT: Holiday, Short Swing, or Relief Day.
Holiday Pay: Separate 8:00 straight-time payment when eligibility is confirmed; requires working the following day unless that day is a regular relief day, approved vacation day, or approved personal day.
Night differential: actual time between 8:00 PM and 5:59 AM.
Meal Period: 20 minutes at time-and-one-half.
Freight Meal: 40 minutes at time-and-one-half.
Fuel Claim: 30 minutes at time-and-one-half.
Daily Cert: $10 once per normal worked shift; excluded from Special Shifts.
Trainee: 1 hour straight time per trainee, maximum 2.
Operating Without a Conductor: 8 hours straight time.
Yard Certification: 1 hour straight time per certification.
Commingle / Sheridan-Shop-House Move: each adds 8 hours straight time.
2 Classes of Service: compares the 8-hour straight-time payment with ordinary overtime attributable to the pull and uses the greater payment; the same pull is not paid both ways.
Terminal Not In Crew Book: 2 hours straight time.
Runaround Claim: 2 hours straight time plus the entered difference in earnings, all straight time.
Time on Time: variable additional straight-time payment, maximum 8:00 per shift.
Miscellaneous Penalty: user-entered description and duration paid at the selected straight-time or overtime rate.
Vacation Week: 1/52 of previous year gross earnings, minimum five basic days.
Single Vacation Day: 1/5 of the vacation-week value, minimum one basic day.

Welcome to Engineer Pay Log

A personal, unofficial pay-tracking tool for locomotive engineers.
Unofficial personal tracking tool. This app is not an official Long Island Rail Road, MTA, or union product. Always verify payroll questions against official records, agreements, and your pay statement.
Your data is available offline and syncs with your account. Engineer Pay Log keeps a local copy on this device so you can continue using the app when railroad connectivity is unreliable. When you are signed in and online, your shift history synchronizes automatically with your Engineer Pay Log account so it can follow you across devices.
Backup JSON remains available as an extra safeguard. Cloud sync is designed to keep your account data available across devices, while Settings → Backup JSON lets you keep your own separate copy whenever you want one.

Enable Net Pay Estimator?

A planning estimate based on your own paycheck history.

Net Pay Estimator uses the average take-home percentage from your last 10 paychecks to estimate future net pay.

Because taxes, deductions, benefits, contributions, withholding, and other payroll items vary from employee to employee, this is an estimate only and is not a guarantee of your actual paycheck.

To use this feature, enter the gross and net amounts from your 10 most recent paychecks. These amounts can be found in the BSC portal. Keeping your paycheck history current will improve the estimate.

What's New in Engineer Pay Log 10.2 — Deadhead Watch

This update introduces Deadhead Watch, a new way to keep an eye on the LIRR trains you normally use to get to and from work.

Save Your Commute

In Settings → My Job, save the LIRR train or trains you normally use for each workday. EPL matches those trips to the current schedule and saves a baseline for comparison.

Automatic Schedule Monitoring

Once your commute is matched, EPL can periodically compare your saved trips against current LIRR schedule data — even while the app is closed.

Deadhead Watch Alerts

If EPL detects that a saved train time, route, or availability has changed, Deadhead Watch can alert you and take you directly to the affected commute for review.

Your Baseline Stays Under Your Control

EPL will never silently replace your saved commute when it detects a change. If a trip needs attention, you can review it and rematch it yourself.

Deadhead Watch monitors published schedule changes. It is not a live train-status or delay-alert system and should not be used as a substitute for official LIRR service information.

This update also includes the latest Crew Book revision-label improvements and other reliability fixes.

Thank you for using Engineer Pay Log and for all of the feedback that continues to make the app better.

— Justin
